about: Documented exceptions to the licence gate (scripts/licenses.mjs). Each entry caps a finding at `level` (warn by default; notice or ok also allowed) and must say why. `until` (YYYY-MM-DD) makes an exception lapse; an entry that matches nothing is reported so this file stays honest. `name` may end with * to match a prefix. `license` is the licence text the decision was about: a finding whose licence has changed since is reported again, not waived.

exceptions.name: tldraw
exceptions.reason: tldraw SDK is under the custom 'tldraw license' (not OSI); production use needs a tldraw licence key. Kept as a warning until the owner decides: buy a licence, ship with the watermark terms, or replace the whiteboard.

exceptions.name: @tldraw/*
exceptions.reason: Same tldraw licence for @tldraw/editor, @tldraw/utils and @tldraw/validate (the other @tldraw packages are MIT).

exceptions.name: hspell-he-dictionary
exceptions.reason: AGPL-3.0 Hspell word list: never bundled. The app fetches it from upstream (wooorm/dictionaries) only after an explicit user command and names the licence first (HEBREW_DICT_LICENSE in src/ai/hebrewSpell.ts), so Lumen does not distribute it.

exceptions.name: webr
exceptions.reason: webR's binaries are GPL-3.0 (its LICENSE.md) and scripts/copy-webr.mjs ships them for live R blocks. Pending the owner's decision (plan 15.10): make R a user-initiated download (like Hspell), or drop live R. Lapses on 2026-11-15 so it cannot stay silent.

exceptions.name: aya-expanse:8b
exceptions.reason: Aya Expanse is CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial), so it must leave the model catalog. The removal is plan 1.7, in the next PR of this stack (fix/model-catalog, #200), which also deletes this entry. Lapses on 2026-10-25 so it cannot linger.
